snippet.title: Kron Wars is on Steam — Wishlist Now | Browser Space-Trading MMO
snippet.description:
Kron Wars is on Steam — and wishlisting now genuinely helps us. 🚀

Kron Wars is a modern, browser-based space-trading MMO: trade, mine, fight, claim planets and build an empire across a living galaxy of 5,000 sectors that keeps running while you're offline. No download — it runs right in your browser.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4731070/Kron_Wars/
▶ Play the closed beta (browser, no install): https://kronwars.com

Why the wishlist matters: Steam surfaces games with wishlist momentum, and we're heading into Steam Next Fest in October 2026. For a three-person team, every wishlist is a real push toward being seen. It takes ten seconds.

Kron Wars is a modern take on the classic BBS space-trading games — a fresh, deeper spin on the genre that started it all, built with .NET 10, Microsoft Orleans and Blazor WebAssembly.

── Follow the build ──
🌐 Site & beta: https://kronwars.com
𝕏 / Twitter: https://x.com/KronWarsGame
🦋 Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/kronwars.bsky.social
💬 Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/KronWars/

Made by Alien Bulb. New devlogs every couple of weeks — subscribe and ring the bell to be first into the next beta wave. o7
